# FileUploader

## FileUploader, FileUploaderButton, FileUploaderDropContainer, FileUploaderItem, Filename, FileUploaderSkeleton

- **Picking.** The button, the drop area and the uploader pick through the
  host's `adapters.FilePicker`, a function (`FilePicker({ accept, multiple })`
  returning a promise of `{ name, size, type }` entries). Without it a document's hidden
  file input stands in (`behaviors/dom.js` `pickFiles`); a host with neither
  (a native host without the adapter) draws the picking rows disabled and
  reports `adapter_missing`. Dropping files is web only: the drop area
  listens on its own node for drag events, which a native host never sends.
- **Validation.** A drop area marks an entry `invalidFileType` when it is
  larger than `maxFileSize` or both its type and its extension (found by
  `pattern`) are outside a non-empty `accept`; the uploader checks only
  `maxFileSize` (its chooser filters by `accept`), reports every entry
  through `onAddFiles` and lists the valid ones.
- **Filename** is the status seat both upstream parents wrap it in (the
  state container): every upstream rule for its parts is scoped there, so a
  bare upstream Filename draws the browser's own button. Its reference mount
  wraps it the same way.
- **Standalone members.** FileUploaderButton, FileUploaderDropContainer and
  FileUploaderItem render on their own as upstream does (the drag-and-drop
  pattern composes the drop area and items without an uploader), so none
  requires a parent.
- **Not drawn.** A name cut by the item's width shows no tooltip (upstream
  wraps a cut name in one); the uploader's list keeps no files across a
  remount, as upstream's internal list; `warn` has no upstream look here.

## FileUploader

FileUploader lists the files a person picks under a title, a description and the picking button.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `adapter` - fallback: draws disabled without an adapter |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `labelTitle` | `string` | no | The title over the description. |
| `labelDescription` | `string` | no | The description over the button; it describes the button. |
| `buttonLabel` | `string` | no | The picking button's label. |
| `buttonKind` | `string` | no | The picking button's Button kind. Default `primary`. |
| `size` | `string` | no | The button and list size: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. Default `md`. |
| `filenameStatus` | `string` | no | Every listed file's status: `uploading`, `edit` or `complete`. Default `uploading`. |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | no | The listed files' status accessible name. |
| `accept` | `array` | no | File types and extensions the chooser offers. |
| `maxFileSize` | `number` | no | Largest listed size in bytes; larger picks are reported, not listed. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | no | Lets the chooser return several files and adds them to the list. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables the button and draws the labels and files disabled. |
| `onAddFiles` | `function` | no | Called with `{ addedFiles }` after a pick, oversize entries marked `invalidFileType`. |
| `onChange` | `function` | no | Called with the listed files after each change. |
| `onDelete` | `function` | no | Called with the removed file's entry. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `descriptionGap` | `control.file_uploader_description_gap` |
| `itemGap` | `control.file_uploader_item_gap` |
| `listGap` | `control.file_uploader_list_gap` |
| `titleGap` | `control.file_uploader_title_gap` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"labelTitle":"Upload files","labelDescription":"Max file size is 500 MB. Only .jpg files are supported.","buttonLabel":"Add file","buttonKind":"primary","size":"md","filenameStatus":"edit"}` |
| sm | `{"labelTitle":"Upload files","labelDescription":"Max file size is 500 MB. Only .jpg files are supported.","buttonLabel":"Add file","buttonKind":"primary","size":"sm","filenameStatus":"edit"}` |
| lg | `{"labelTitle":"Upload files","labelDescription":"Max file size is 500 MB. Only .jpg files are supported.","buttonLabel":"Add file","buttonKind":"primary","size":"lg","filenameStatus":"edit"}` |
| tertiary | `{"labelTitle":"Upload files","labelDescription":"Max file size is 500 MB. Only .jpg files are supported.","buttonLabel":"Add file","buttonKind":"tertiary","size":"md","filenameStatus":"edit"}` |
| disabled | `{"labelTitle":"Upload files","labelDescription":"Max file size is 500 MB. Only .jpg files are supported.","buttonLabel":"Add file","buttonKind":"primary","size":"md","filenameStatus":"edit","disabled":true}` |

## FileUploaderButton

FileUploaderButton is a button that opens the file chooser and reports the chosen files.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `adapter` - fallback: draws disabled without an adapter |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `labelText` | `string` | no | The button's label. Default "Add file". |
| `buttonKind` | `string` | no | The Button kind. Default `primary`. |
| `size` | `string` | no | The Button size: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. Default `md`. |
| `accept` | `array` | no | File types and extensions the chooser offers. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | no | Lets the chooser return several files. |
| `disableLabelChanges` | `boolean` | no | Keeps the label after a pick instead of naming the chosen files. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables the button. |
| `onChange` | `function` | no | Called with the chosen entries (`{ name, size, type }`). |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | Accessible name when the label alone does not say what the button picks. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the button. |

### Metrics

None: every value this component draws is a token named in its props or listed under `tokens`.

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"labelText":"Add file","buttonKind":"primary","size":"md"}` |
| sm | `{"labelText":"Add file","buttonKind":"primary","size":"sm"}` |
| lg | `{"labelText":"Add file","buttonKind":"primary","size":"lg"}` |
| secondary | `{"labelText":"Add file","buttonKind":"secondary","size":"md"}` |
| tertiary | `{"labelText":"Add file","buttonKind":"tertiary","size":"md"}` |
| ghost | `{"labelText":"Add file","buttonKind":"ghost","size":"md"}` |
| disabled | `{"labelText":"Add file","buttonKind":"primary","size":"md","disabled":true}` |

## FileUploaderDropContainer

FileUploaderDropContainer is a dashed area that takes dropped files or opens the file chooser when pressed.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `adapter` - fallback: draws disabled without an adapter |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `labelText` | `string` | no | The area's label; it is also its accessible name. Default "Add file". |
| `accept` | `array` | no | File types and extensions accepted; others are marked `invalidFileType`. Empty accepts all. |
| `pattern` | `string` | no | The expression that finds a name's extension. Default `\.[0-9a-z]+$`. |
| `maxFileSize` | `number` | no | Largest accepted size in bytes; larger files are marked `invalidFileType`. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | no | Adds every picked or dropped file instead of the first. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables picking and dropping. |
| `onAddFiles` | `function` | no | Called with `(event, { addedFiles })` after a pick or a drop. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | Accessible name when the label alone does not say what the area takes. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the area. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `borderWidth` | `border.width_01` |
| `height` | `control.file_uploader_drop_height` |
| `maxWidth` | `control.file_uploader_drop_max_width` |
| `padding` | `control.file_uploader_drop_padding` |
| `ringWidth` | `control.file_uploader_drop_outline_width_active` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"labelText":"Drag and drop files here or click to upload"}` |
| disabled | `{"disabled":true,"labelText":"Drag and drop files here or click to upload"}` |

## FileUploaderItem

FileUploaderItem is one chosen file's row: its name, its status seat and, when invalid, the error message.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | no | The file's name, one line cut with an ellipsis. |
| `status` | `string` | no | The status seat's state: `uploading`, `edit` or `complete`. Default `uploading`. |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | no | The status's accessible name. |
| `size` | `string` | no | One of `variants`: `sm`, `md`; the large row when omitted. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | no | Draws the error outline and, with `errorSubject`, the message. |
| `errorSubject` | `string` | no | The error message's title. |
| `errorBody` | `string` | no | The error message's text under the title. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Draws the name disabled and disables the close button. |
| `uuid` | `string` | no | The id `onDelete` reports; a generated one when omitted. |
| `onDelete` | `function` | no | Called with `(event, { uuid })` when the close button is pressed in the `edit` status. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

## Filename

Filename is the status seat of a file row: a small spinner while uploading, a close button to remove the file, or a checkmark once complete.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | no | The file's name; it completes the close button's accessible name. |
| `status` | `string` | no | One of `kinds`: `uploading` (a small spinner), `edit` (the close button) or `complete` (a checkmark). Default `uploading`. |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | no | The status's accessible name. Default "Uploading file". |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | no | Draws the error glyph before the close button. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disables the close button. |
| `onPress` | `function` | no | Called when the close button is pressed (press, Enter, Space). |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the close button. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `glyph` | `control.field_icon_size` |
| `invalidGap` | `control.file_uploader_invalid_icon_gap` |
| `paddingEnd` | `control.file_uploader_state_padding_end` |
| `seat` | `control.file_uploader_close_size` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"name":"report.pdf","status":"edit","iconDescription":"Delete file"}` |
| invalid | `{"invalid":true,"name":"report.pdf","status":"edit","iconDescription":"Delete file"}` |
| disabled | `{"name":"report.pdf","status":"edit","iconDescription":"Delete file","disabled":true}` |
| complete | `{"name":"report.pdf","status":"complete","iconDescription":"Delete file"}` |
| uploading | `{"name":"report.pdf","status":"uploading","iconDescription":"Delete file"}` |
